arguments.content:
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to release'
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
      - name: Set version
        run: |
          sed -i "s/^version = .*/version = \"${{ github.event.inputs.version }}\"/" pyproject.toml
      - name: Commit and push version bump
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          git push
      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
          name: Release v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
          draft: true
          generate_release_notes: true

steps.message: I have added a new GitHub Action workflow `.github/workflows/release.yml` to automate the release preparation process. This workflow allows triggering a release via `workflow_dispatch`, which takes a version number as input, updates the version in `pyproject.toml`, commits and pushes the change, and creates a draft GitHub release with automatically generated release notes.
